name: Juliet Mitchell
shortBio: British psychoanalyst and feminist theorist who reclaimed Freudian and Lacanian psychoanalysis as an indispensable structural critique of patriarchal oppression and pioneered the lateral sibling axis in psychic formation.
centralQuestion: How does the unconscious internalize and reproduce patriarchal kinship structures, and how do lateral sibling bonds structure identity alongside vertical parental authority?

keyWorks.title: Psychoanalysis and Feminism: Freud, Reich, Laing and Women
keyWorks.description: Groundbreaking defense of psychoanalysis demonstrating that Freud describes patriarchal oppression rather than prescriptive biology.

keyWorks.title: Mad Men and Medusas: Reclaiming Hysteria
keyWorks.description: Re-evaluates hysteria as a fundamental psychological response to lateral and sibling disempowerment.

keyWorks.title: Siblings: Sex and Violence
keyWorks.description: Introduces the lateral axis as an autonomous dimension of unconscious desire, rivalry, and identification distinct from parental verticality.
